name: blit_box_default
description: With no mode/coeffs the default box is the full source [0,dim] per axis -- an identity copy.

name: blit_box_full
description: An explicit full-source box M0,3,0,3 (min,max per axis, in source pixels) copies the source unchanged.
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,3,0,3
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_box_subregion
description: A box selects a source sub-rectangle (x columns 1..3) and stretches it to fill the dest; nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M1,3,0,3 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_box_flip_x
description: A box flips an axis when its range runs backwards: M2.5,-0.5 on axis 0 (= [dim-0.5, -0.5], reversed + half-texel inset to land on pixel centers) mirrors each row left<->right. nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M2.5,-0.5,0,3 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_box_flip_y
description: Reversing the axis-1 range (M...,2.5,-0.5) flips the matrix top<->bottom, leaving axis 0 as-is. nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,3,2.5,-0.5 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_box_flip_180
description: Reversing both axes flips the matrix in both directions -- a 180-degree turn (every element reversed). nearest filter (F1).

name: blit_map_axes
description: map's triples are (srcAxis,min,max) positional by dest axis: M0,0,3,1,1,3 = dest0<-src0 full, dest1<-src1 rows 1..3 -- i.e. it generalizes box (same as box M0,3,1,3). nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"map" M0,0,3,1,1,3 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_map_default
description: map with no triples leaves every dest axis identity (dest k <- src k, full source) -- an identity copy.
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"map"
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_map_transpose
description: Pointing each dest axis at the OTHER source axis (M1,0,3,0,0,3 = dest0<-src1, dest1<-src0) transposes the matrix (reflect across the main diagonal). nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"map" M1,0,3,0,0,3 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_map_rotate_cw
description: A quarter turn clockwise = swap axes + reverse the swapped-in axis: M1,2.5,-0.5,0,0,3 (dest0<-src1 reversed, dest1<-src0). nearest filter (F1).

name: blit_map_rotate_ccw
description: A quarter turn counter-clockwise = the other swap + reverse: M1,0,3,0,2.5,-0.5 (dest0<-src1, dest1<-src0 reversed). nearest filter (F1).

name: blit_map_by_index
description: Mode by index T2 == map; a single triple (0,1,3) sets dest0<-src0 over [1,3] and leaves dest1 identity (== box [1,3] on axis 0). nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T2 M0,1,3 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_affine_identity
description: Affine mode with the identity matrix (linear part + zero translation) copies the source.
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"affine" M1,0,0,0,1,0
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_mode_by_index
description: The transform mode accepts an index: T1 == affine.

name: blit_offset
description: Offset mode uses direct pixel coordinates: M1,0 means dest[x,y] = source[x+1,y]. Zero edge exposes the vacated final column.
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"offset" M1,0 F1 E3
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_offset_by_index
description: The transform mode index T3 selects offset. M-1,0 samples the source pixel immediately to the left, with zero beyond the edge.
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T3 M-1,0 F1 E3
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_offset_fractional
description: Offset remains composable with filtering: M0.5,0 linearly interpolates halfway between horizontal source pixels; hold edge keeps the last column.
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"offset" M0.5,0 E1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_offset_region
description: P/S clips writes in absolute destination coordinates. At destination [1,1], offset M-1,-1 samples source [0,0].
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"offset" M-1,-1 P1,1 S1,1 F1 E3
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_magnify_nearest
description: A half-extent box [0,1.5] per axis magnifies the top-left 2x2 of the source; nearest filter (F1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,1.5,0,1.5 F1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_magnify_linear
description: Same half-extent box with the default linear filter interpolates between source texels (fractional result).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,1.5,0,1.5
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_filter_per_axis
description: F is per-axis: F0,1 = linear on X (smooth, fractional), nearest on Y (blocky) -- a magnify interpolates columns but steps rows.

name: blit_filter_by_name
description: Per-axis options also take names: F"linear","nearest" == F0,1 (a comma-separated quoted-string list, which parses identically in both engines).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,1.5,0,1.5 F"linear","nearest"
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_translate_hold
description: An axis-0 shifted box [1.2,4.2] with nearest filter + hold edge shifts and clamps at the edge (F1 E1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M1.2,4.2,0,3 F1 E1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_operator_add
description: Q combines the sampled value into the destination cell: a default (full-source) blit with add onto a dest pre-filled with 10.

name: blit_operator_add_by_index
description: G40 resolves the frozen compact operator value Q2 to add.

name: blit_minify_lerp
description: Lerp WITH minify: a 1.5x oversized box [0,4.5] with the default linear filter (a point filter, no fold) ignores the footprint and just lerps the centre -- interpolated but aliased. linear coexists with minify; a fold (mean/min/max/add) is opt-in. Hold edge (E1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,4.5,0,4.5 E1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_minify_mean
description: Explicit mean filter (F2): the 2x box [0,6] box-averages each cell's footprint (anti-aliases). mean is one filter value, not what linear does implicitly. Hold edge (E1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,6,0,6 F2 E1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_minify_max
description: F4 = max: the 2x minify pools the footprint maximum instead of averaging. Hold edge (E1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,6,0,6 F4 E1
G10 R"bd"

name: blit_minify_pool
description: Separable per-axis filter: F4,2 = max-pool X (F4) but mean-pool Y (F2). Differs from a uniform fold, proving the filter is per-axis. Hold edge (E1).
program:
G40 R"bs" W"bd" T"box" M0,6,0,6 F4,2 E1
G10 R"bd"

name: flow_define_only

name: flow_define_run
description: T11 runs a previously defined procedure body.

P10 V42
T0
T11 R"p"

name: flow_unknown
description: Running an undefined procedure reports failure (an F<code> arg on the return).

name: flow_nested
description: Procedures may be defined and run nested.

T10 L"inner"
P10 V7
T0
T0
T11 R"outer"
T11 R"inner"

name: cond_all_true
description: T9 A runs the block when all values are truthy.

name: cond_all_false
description: T9 A skips the block when a value is falsy.

name: cond_all_mixed
description: T9 A requires every value truthy; a mix skips.

name: cond_any_true
description: T9 Y runs the block when any value is truthy.

name: cond_any_false
description: T9 Y skips the block when no value is truthy.

name: cond_nested_skip

program:

T9 A1
P10 V1
T0
T0
P10 V2

name: iter_single
description: T9 V runs the body once per value, exposing it as $it.
program:
T9 V5 R"it"
P10 V$it
T0

name: iter_zero
description: Iterating an empty value set runs the body zero times.
program:
T9 V$x R"it"
P10 V$it
T0

name: iter_offset
description: T9 P writes each iteration value at a scalar offset in the selected register.

name: range_incl
description: a:b expands to an inclusive integer sweep.

name: range_excl
description: a>b expands to an exclusive sweep (stops before b).

name: range_count
description: a:b/n divides the inclusive range into n points.

name: range_step
description: a:b:s walks the inclusive range in steps of s.

name: range_multiplier
description: a:b:s:m scales each value of the stepped range by the multiplier m.

name: lone_multiplier
description: a*m is the single point start*m (multiplier with no range).

name: range_in_list
description: A range may sit inside a comma list alongside plain values.

name: multiaxis
description: Register-less multi-axis of lone values adds coordinate-wise.

name: multiaxis_range
description: Multi-axis ranges add coordinate-wise (nested register-less sweep).

name: multiaxis_multiplier
description: Multi-axis multipliers add scaled single-point coordinates.

name: range_open_no_register
description: Without a register an open range has no dimension and is one point.

name: ref_bare
description: A bare $name reads the whole register in order.

name: ref_two
description: A reference can appear mid-line, then another follows.

name: ref_unknown
description: An unknown register reference yields no values.

name: ref_subscript
description: $name[i] reads a single indexed scalar.

name: ref_sub_range
description: $name[a:b] reads an inclusive range of indices.

name: ref_sub_list
description: $name[a,b] reads a comma list of indices.

name: ref_sub_open
description: $name[a:] runs from a to the end of the register.

name: ref_sub_open_excl
description: $name[a>] also runs to the end, excluding the dimension itself.

name: ref_sub_open_full
description: $name[0:] reads the whole register.

name: ref_sub_bare_open
description: $name[:] is an open range with no start: the whole register.

name: ref_sub_multi
description: $name[a:b|c:d] expands axes coordinate-wise into flat indices.

name: ref_sub_multi_lone
description: Lone-value multi-axis subscript indexes an exact coordinate.

name: off_origin
description: $x@[0|0] is the flat offset of the origin coordinate.

name: off_coord
description: $x@[a|b] is the flat offset of an exact coordinate.

name: off_coord_list
description: A comma list of coordinates yields each one's flat offset.

name: off_range
description: Explicit coordinate ranges sweep, yielding a block of offsets.

name: off_bare
description: A bare number in an offset ref is the offset itself.

name: unicode_snowman
description: A Unicode character decodes to its code point.

name: unicode_cjk
description: A CJK character decodes to its code point.

name: unicode_greek
description: A Greek letter decodes to its code point.

name: unicode_euro
description: The euro sign decodes to its code point.

name: unicode_emoji
description: An astral-plane emoji decodes to its full code point.

name: unicode_list
description: Unicode characters list like any other values.

name: unicode_range
description: A Unicode character can be the start of a range.

name: unicode_range_multi
description: Unicode code points combine on multiple axes.

name: unicode_adjacent
description: Adjacent Unicode characters are separate values.

name: unicode_negated
description: A sign before a Unicode character negates its code point.

name: unitary_one
description: K is the unitary constant one.

name: unitary_zero
description: Z is the unitary constant zero.

name: unitary_minusone
description: N is the unitary constant minus one.

name: unitary_range
description: A unitary constant acts as a range bound like any number.

name: unitary_range_excl
description: Z as an exclusive range bound sweeps 0 up to (not including) 10.

name: unitary_pi
description: π decodes to the mathematical constant.

name: unitary_tau
description: τ decodes to 2π.

name: unitary_before_number
description: A unitary directly followed by a number is two values.

name: unitary_after_number
description: A number directly followed by a unitary is two values.

name: unitary_pair
description: Adjacent unitaries are separate values.

name: unitary_exponent_unaffected
description: Scientific notation is unaffected by unitary completion.

name: unitary_negated
description: A sign before a constant negates it.

name: unitary_negated_symbol
description: A sign negates a symbolic constant.

name: unitary_negated_twice
description: Negating a negative constant yields a positive value.
